narrative:
## ALCO & Board Submission — NIM Consolidation

The FY2026 NII & margin plan is ready for ALCO and Management Board approval.

## Key Decisions
- FY2026 NII PLN 3.33B, NIM 3.92%, finance gate passed
- Deposit beta held at ~38%, inside the 45% ceiling
- Swap overlay extended to protect carry through the cutting cycle

## Recommendations
- Monthly ALCO re-forecast against actual NBP decisions
- Track ex-Citi deposit behaviour as a dedicated model-risk item

## Risk Factors
- Dovish NBP path: -PLN 90M FY2027 downside
- Restructuring execution alongside integration

signals.title: Management Commentary — Rate Headwind
signals.excerpt: Management flagged NBP rate cuts as the key earnings headwind for net interest income, with deposit pricing discipline and balance-sheet growth as offsets.

signals.title: Target Organisation — Restructuring Programme
signals.excerpt: VeloBank announced a target-organisation programme affecting up to 950 roles to align the combined bank's cost base after the Citi integration.
